# Alejandro BGN — engineering evidence portfolio
> Canonical origin: https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/
> Updated 2026-10-21. All materials are public-safe and authored or curated by the site owner.

## Executive evidence
- [Enterprise AI team activation](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/work/cybersecurity-ai-engineering): An anonymized delivery-team account of agent-assisted SDLC activation, not a client-wide adoption audit.
- [Source-to-evidence modernization](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/work/banking-modernization): Bounded proof of concept, not an estate-wide migration or functional parity claim.
- [Professional experience](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/experience): Roles, boundaries and technical responsibility.

## Inspectable engineering
- [Portfolio evidence atlas](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/atlas): Canonical clickable map of editorial relationships.
- [Machine-readable graph](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/atlas/graph.json): Versioned links, IDs and descriptions. Connections are editorial, not deployed runtime dependencies.
- [Systems catalogue](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/systems): Public systems, prototypes and their documented limits.
- [Standalone HTML labs](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/labs): Eight recovered experiments. Rendering a UI does not prove integrations, production readiness or full execution.
- [Technical writing](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/writing): Engineering field notes.
- [AI Co-Evolution](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/evolution): 201 records, distinguishing 184 historical reconstructions and 17 later milestones.
- [Independent publications](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/publications): Editorial work, separate from production engineering evidence.

## Interpretation
- Customer names, source code, internal screenshots, business data and unpublished project metrics are intentionally withheld.
- Reported process measurements reflect the delivery team's stated scope; no independent client audit, measured client savings or functional equivalence is implied.
- Original Anatomy illustrations and new interactive SVG explainers are illustrative teaching models. They do not issue real PRs, approvals, provider calls or production actions.
- The public URL above is the site's only canonical origin. Vercel-generated preview addresses are not canonical citations.

- [Public claim boundary ledger](https://alejandrobgn.vercel.app/evidence/claims.json): Delivery-team-reported metrics, their scopes and caveats; not independently audited customer KPIs.
